title: ChangeEntry
description: `seshi/change/1`: one entry of an owner's change feed, `owners/<owner>/changes/<stamp>-<archive_id>-<suffix>-<content_hash|tombstone|visibility>.json` (unique: a random suffix). Append-only; written before the session pointer moves, so an entry may name a change that did not happen (readers read the current metadata). Readers tail the feed by key. Every entry records its writer (X5.5).

kind.description: `published`: a new trace is the head. `tombstone`: the session's traces were removed (see `reason`). `visibility_changed`: who may read it changed (X5.10).

format.description: The format the session is filed under (its metadata's `format`), which every session route takes. Entries written before 0.15 have none; the change feeds fill it from the session's metadata when they serve them.

content_hash.description: The trace the entry is about; for a tombstone or a visibility change, the head at the time (null when there was none).

replace.description: On `published`: the trace replaces the session's earlier traces instead of extending them (X4.6), and they were removed; a reader drops what it held of the session. Absent otherwise.

owner_basis.description: How the session's owner was established (X5.5), as metadata records it.

reason.description: Why a session was tombstoned: `deleted` by its owner or an admin, `retracted` by the machine that uploaded it (F9.7), or `redacted` by an operator. On a `published` entry with `replace`, `redacted` says a redaction backfill rewrote the session's traces with new rules (F2.5); absent on other publishes.
